wins.text: Record AUM of $13.5 trillion with $205 billion of net inflows in Q3, driving 10% annualized organic base fee growth — highest quarter since 2021
iShares ETFs generated a record $153 billion of net inflows in Q3, crossing $5 trillion in AUM; active ETFs gathered $40+ billion year-to-date, roughly doubling prior year
Q3 revenue of $6.5 billion increased 25% year-over-year; operating income of $2.6 billion up 23% YoY; performance fees of $516 million up 33% YoY

HPS contributed ~$225 million in base fees and ~$270 million in performance fees in its first full quarter post-close; GIP V closed above its $25 billion target — largest-ever client capital raise in a private infrastructure fund
Cash management platform crossed $1 trillion in AUM, growing 45% in 3 years; Circle reserve fund mandate surpassed $64 billion; BUIDL tokenized fund grew to nearly $3 billion

risks.text: EPS of $11.55 increased only 1% YoY despite strong revenue growth, weighed down by $84 million noncash mark-to-market loss on Circle investment and significantly higher diluted share count from GIP (6.9M shares) and HPS (8.5M SubCo units) transactions

As-adjusted operating margin of 44.6% declined 120 bps year-over-year, reflecting drag from higher performance fee-related compensation; ongoing low-teens core G&A expense growth expected in 2025 from M&A onboarding

Analyst scrutiny on private credit quality amid reported bankruptcies and potential fraud cases in syndicated loan and consumer ABF markets, though management characterized these as idiosyncratic rather than systemic
Regulatory and legislative pathway for private markets in 401(k)/DC plans remains uncertain with 'significant work ahead,' creating execution risk on a key growth initiative

HPS performance fees expected to be 'slightly lower' in Q4 vs. Q3's $270 million, and infrastructure flows noted to have 'periodicity' with episodic large transactions, introducing near-term revenue variability

guidance_items.detail: Continue to expect low-teens percentage increase in 2025 core G&A expense, consistent with prior guidance
Q4 share repurchases of at least $375 million anticipated, consistent with previous guidance
25% projected as-adjusted tax rate for Q4 2025, unchanged from prior guidance
HPS management fees: Q3 is a good starting point for modeling; performance fees expected slightly lower in Q4
Long-term organic base fee growth target of 5%+ (set at June Investor Day) reiterated; management expressed confidence in sustaining 6-7%+ consistently

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Private credit quality deterioration and specific bankruptcy/fraud cases in syndicated loan and consumer ABF markets
ETF share class structure for mutual funds and implications for the active ETF landscape
Integration approach for alpha-oriented private market businesses (GIP, HPS) within the One BlackRock model
